title: Work-tape variable numbering
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean-valued tape symbols, and let $n,s,i,j,b$ be natural numbers. The work-variable number is $\mathrm{workOffset}(M,n)+3((2s+1)i+j)+b$, where $\mathrm{workOffset}(M,n)$ is the work-block offset for $M$ and input length $n$.
